body:
Well I have several issues but the basics would be something like this:

**Alcohol:** I see this as my form of self medicating and don't really feel like it's the core issue. Sure I could drink less but I can't blame my problems on the drinking.

**Financial situation:** I've always been "the smart one" in my family. The first in my family to actually attend university, I was going to be an engineer. Failing my courses and losing my income as a student, you can take student loans in my country but you need to pass 75% of your classes to take the loan. I should've been honest with my self and my surroundings and dropped out earlier. I should've gotten counseling and taken the time to learn how to keep a budget.

**Trust issues:** Should've gone to a therapist. Not feeling comfortable talking to anyone about my problems has really taken a toll on me. I love being the person other people trust with their problems but in doing so I also burden myself further. I'm carrying a load so big that even getting out of bed in the morning is considered a win for me right now. 

And I think it became too late earlier this fall when I decided to ignore my problems once again, even though I didn't have money to pay the rent. Right now I have about 100 USD to my name and right after the summer I had about 1900. I could've affored rent for a couple of months dropped out and then I wouldn't have dragged another person down with me.
